trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 45-degree convergence angle; pixel-depth accounts for roughly 1/6th of total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged peaks and valleys along the distal half of both trailing edges, with more pronounced serrations on the left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior curve on both lobes, tapering sharply toward the lateral tips and descending steeply toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips and at irregular intervals along the trailing edge, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white scarring or calloused tissue at the trailing edge margins and both lobe tips.
